decisions.reason: Only a brief mention with no quantified results or dedicated page suggests performance below aspiration, triggering problemistic search and likely reallocation of resources to more promising products.
Winning the Deutscher Verpackungspreis is a clear success above the firm's aspiration level, so it is kept.
A dedicated product page indicates active market presence and, given organizational slack, the firm can keep this still-uncertain product while evaluating results.
A dedicated page shows commitment and the product remains within normal aspirations for a newly launched display, so slack supports keeping it.
A dedicated page and the product's niche as a large freestanding display suggest it meets minimum aspirations, so keep with low drop probability.
